title: GTA VI Unlocks at 11 Tonight in Laredo — and Some Xbox Players Are Already in Vice City
excerpt: GTA VI unlocks at 11 p.m. Central tonight in Laredo, and some Xbox players are already in Vice City thanks to the “New Zealand trick.”
content:
Laredo gamers, clear your plans tonight. Grand Theft Auto VI unlocks at 11 p.m. Central tonight — midnight Eastern — on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S, and the most anticipated game of the decade is finally about to be playable in the 956.

Rockstar Games set the launch for midnight local time on Thursday, November 19, in all regions. Because the United States unlocks as one region at midnight Eastern, the game opens at 11 p.m. Wednesday in Laredo — an hour earlier on the clock than the calendar date suggests.

Some players, though, did not wait. New Zealand reached midnight first, at 5 a.m. Central on Wednesday, and Xbox players reported getting into Vice City hours early by changing their console’s location to New Zealand and restarting it — a workaround players call the “New Zealand trick.” VICE reported on Wednesday that Xbox Series X|S players got in that way, citing players on Reddit. The trick is not official early access: Rockstar has not announced any early access, and the game unlocks at the same published time for every edition.

PlayStation players do not get the same shortcut. A copy bought on a U.S. PlayStation account stays locked until the U.S. unlock, whatever the console settings say; playing early on PS5 takes a separate account registered in New Zealand and a second copy from New Zealand’s store. No ban has been confirmed for using the trick, and neither Sony nor Microsoft has announced one for GTA VI — though Xbox’s own rules say to change your country or region only if you have moved.

The Standard Edition costs $79.99 and the Ultimate Edition $99.99, which adds extra vehicles, weapons and outfits — not earlier play. Rockstar has not announced a PC release date. The single-player story follows Jason and Lucia after a score goes wrong, pulling them into a criminal conspiracy across Leonida, Rockstar’s fictional Florida, and back to Vice City. Take-Two, Rockstar’s parent company, said preorders had reached “unprecedented levels” ahead of launch.

The launch comes one day after GTA VI picked up eight nominations at The Game Awards 2026, including Game of the Year — the most of any game this year, announced before the game was playable anywhere.
